g.title: arch
g.text: Three-layer closed-loop architecture: AI-driven network digital twin for safe decision testing

g.title: d_data
g.text: • Yen k = 4 min-hop candidate paths per OD pair
• capacities and demands ÷ max link capacity
• train / val / held-aside time splits; GEANT, Kdl unseen

g.title: d_twin
g.text: • path features: demand, split fraction, hop count
• per-member MLP multiplier, initialised at physics (= 1)
• μ = ensemble mean, σ = ensemble spread

g.title: d_dec
g.text: • GNN on the link–path bipartite graph
• optional relative-σ veto (off in frozen config)
• LP only if a forced-link lower bound ≤ 1

g.title: net
g.text: applies the routing and returns realised link loads
